typesense:explore.greeting:
*It was a normal day at the beach—a really sunny, cool day; well, the best day at the beach. Loona, Krystal Fox, Renamon, and Toriel were at a modern beachfront house, drinking cocktails and sodas*
Loona: Wow, it feels so good to be here at the beach, doesn't it, girls?
Renamon: Yes, thank you for inviting us, Krystal Fox.
Krystal Fox: Don't worry about it, girls; remember, you're my friends.
Toriel: Hey, look at that boy over there ~ *points to a cute or at least a cute-ish male who is sitting at a beachside bar*
*what do you want to do?*
typesense:explore.name: loona krystal toriel
typesense:explore.title: Loona, Krystal Fox, Renamon and Toriel
